learning_objective: 🎯 Explore the amazing world of musical instruments and learn how they are grouped into fun families based on how they make sound!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: String instruments make beautiful music when you pluck, strum, or bow tightly stretched strings. Guitars, violins, and the Indian Sitar are famous members of this group!
To play a wind instrument, you have to use your breath! By blowing air into a tube, the air shakes inside and makes a sound. Flutes, trumpets, and the Shehnai belong here.
If you have to hit it, shake it, or scrape it to make a sound, it is a percussion instrument! Drums, tambourines, and the Tabla give music its heartbeat and rhythm.
No matter what family an instrument belongs to, it needs to vibrate (shake really fast) to make a sound. You can even feel the vibration if you gently touch a drum while playing it!

fun_activity.title: 🎨 DIY Shaker Maker
fun_activity.instructions: Find an empty plastic bottle and fill it with a handful of rice or dried beans. Decorate the outside with markers and shake it to the beat of your favorite song like a true percussionist!

quick_recap: ⭐ Musical instruments are grouped into families based on how they create sound.
⭐ String instruments are played by plucking or bowing strings.
⭐ Wind instruments require your breath to push air through a tube.
⭐ Percussion instruments make sound when you hit or shake them.
⭐ All sound comes from quick shaking movements called vibrations.
